description: PlanetScale is a hosted MySQL/Vitess and Postgres database platform. This app connects ChatGPT to your PlanetScale databases so it can diagnose slow or failing queries and fix them. It reads schemas, runs queries, and uses PlanetScale Insights to identify the exact query or index problem behind a slow endpoint, then recommends or applies the change with safeguards for destructive operations. It also reviews logs and cluster sizes, searches documentation, and manages billing through Stripe Checkout.

defaultPrompt: Triage my connected codebase with Insights and query errors. Implement and test a code fix; ask before database changes.
Review my most expensive queries, schema, and recent query errors. Rank the findings and recommend evidence-backed improvements.
Use PlanetScale docs to help me choose an engine, create a database, connect my app, and run my first query.
